_what: How the Workshop screen (src/workspace/workshop-screen.tsx, through src/work-workshop.mjs) says each Workshop fact in plain words. made_by: the words the Workshop's own replies use for who made a tool (src/workshop.mjs madeByOf), each shown as `label`, sorted by `order`, with `badge` on the card when the person should notice it and `shareable` when its screen offers Share (the person's own tools: who it reaches, for how long and what they may do is the one share sheet's). run_states: a run's state (src/workshop.mjs view) as a label and a tone. status_tones: the shared status tone (parts/ui StatusVocabulary) each tone word takes on a run's status badge. reported: what the person said after a run (report_result), `none` when nothing was said. worked: the words for what people reported across every account's runs of a tool. places: where a tool runs, in the person's words, and the icon a card shows for the first place it may run, by the place's id (records/workshop-placement-records.json); a place not named here shows its own label with the `default` icon. A new state, maker or place is a row here, never a change to the screen. tool_tiles: the numbers an opened tool shows, each read from its earlier runs (`from`), counted across every account. inputs: how a tool's input reads when it must be given or may be left out. tag_colours: the colour a tone word takes as a tag in a table (parts/ui record-views). screen_icon: the icon a tool's own screen shows when its screen names none. own (on a maker): the tool is this account's own, so its screen offers Rename and Remove; own_tool: the words of those actions and what they answer (src/work-workshop.mjs /tool/<id>/rename and /remove, the same save and delete an AI uses).
